name: xiaoyaoclaw-agent-orchestrator
description: OpenClaw multi-agent daily collaboration orchestrator. Splits tasks, dispatches to resident agents via sessions_send, tracks progress via sessions_list/sessions_history, aggregates results with source attribution, and retries failures (default max 3). Three-tier trigger; reads openclaw.json directly for agents.list and agentToAgent.allow; user-editable agent-roster. Windows & macOS ready, zero-dependency. 中文：多 Agent 日常协作编排器——任务拆解、跨 agent 分发（强制 sessions_send）、进度追踪、结果聚合、失败重试（默认最多 3 次）。三档触发，直接读 openclaw.json，agent-roster 用户可编辑。
